blurb: Guests can challenge themselves on the Lakeside Zip Line course with 7 zip lines and 10 obstacles, including zips up to 400 feet long. Lake rentals include kayaks and paddleboards with all rentals coming with a personal flotation device and paddle. The Adventure Outpost Membership includes kayak and paddleboard rentals for 2 hours, plus bring-a-friend free tickets and discounts on additional guest tickets.
extraNote: Stone Mountain Park Lake Rentals is a cashless location · A daily parking pass ($20) or annual parking pass ($40) is required to enter Stone Mountain Park · In case of severe inclement weather such as storms or unsafe water conditions, reservations may be canceled or rescheduled · If you are not back by the end of your reserved time for lake rentals, you will be charged for extended time · Adventure Outpost check-in desk at Stone Mountain Park Waterfront
